common.portalOff: The client portal is off or no client is assigned, so the client cannot see this yet.
common.readOnly: You can view this page but not change it.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Questions, features, bugs and maintenance requests from the client, submitted on the portal or logged by the team.
requests.empty: No requests yet. Client requests from the portal appear here, and you can log one that came in by phone or email.
requests.logHint: For a request the client made by phone, email or chat. Saqina checks it against the agreed scope.
requests.bodyPlaceholder: What the client asked for, in their words
requests.outOfScopeNote: Out of scope: handle this as a change request so cost and time are agreed first.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The conversation with the client. Decisions discussed here stay with the project.
messages.empty: No messages yet. Start the conversation with the client.
messages.visibility: Visible to the client on the portal. Do not paste internal notes or credentials.
messages.label: Message
messages.placeholder: Write a message to the client

approvals.title: Client approvals
approvals.description: Ask the client to approve a design, a document or a milestone. Nothing changes until they answer.
approvals.documentHint: Only approved or signed documents can be attached. The document is shared with the client.
approvals.linkHint: Optional, for example a design or staging URL.
approvals.cancelBody: The client will no longer be able to answer it.

changes.title: Change requests
changes.description: Work outside the agreed scope, with its cost and time, approved by the client before it starts.
changes.empty: No change requests yet. Create one here or convert a client request.
changes.explain: When the client approves a change request, it is added to the scope, a task is created and the cost becomes a payment term, so the project value increases.
changes.impactPlaceholder: What this changes in the schedule, design or other features
changes.costHint: Use 0 when there is no extra charge.
changes.sendBody: The client sees the cost and time on the portal and can approve or reject it. It can no longer be edited.
changes.decisionHint: Use this when the client decided outside the portal. Say how they decided.
changes.cancelBody: The change request is closed and the client can no longer decide on it.
changes.daysValue: {days, plural, =0 {No extra days} one {# extra day} other {# extra days}}

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Warranty fixes defects in delivered scope; maintenance is paid ongoing support.
maintenance.warrantyHint: Bugs reported until this date are suggested as warranty fixes.
maintenance.warrantyLeft: {days, plural, =0 {Ends today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
maintenance.name: Plan name
maintenance.planScopePlaceholder: Security updates, monthly backups, small content edits
maintenance.renewBody: A new plan with the same terms starts the day after this one ends. This plan is marked as ended.
maintenance.requestsEmpty: No maintenance or bug requests yet.

businessDocs.title: Generate business document
businessDocs.note: Built from scope, schedule and milestones. Missing details stay as [PLACEHOLDERS]. Drafts are not legal advice.

engagement.portalOff: Turn on the client portal and assign a client in project settings first.
engagement.noteRequired: Add a note that says what should change.
engagement.remindedToday: The client was already reminded about this today.
engagement.noRecipients: No one has portal access for this client yet.

cr.notDraft: Only draft change requests can be edited or sent.
cr.notSent: This change request is not waiting for a decision.
cr.evidenceRequired: Say how the client decided (at least 5 characters), for example "Approved by email on 12 Oct".
cr.invalidTransition: This change request cannot move to that status.

documents.shareNeedsApproval: Approve the document before asking the client to review it.
documents.signedLocked: This document is signed and cannot be regenerated.

fields.invalid: A field has an invalid value.
